arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept, photoreal architectural visualization. The main facility occupies the center-right foreground. A clearly separate electrical substation and 2 slender transmission pylons stand behind/left of the facility, all on the RIGHT HALF of the frame. Beyond and right, a small established neighborhood of realistic varied low-rise pitched-roof houses, roads and mature trees. Keep all three subjects fully in-frame with clear physical separation. A visible physical site fence/property edge surrounds only the data center; it does not encompass the substation or community. These are neighboring entities in a fictional landscape, no directed flows, no energy arrows, no glowing power lines, no apparent exported energy or community services. Dark natural rolling terrain and realistically irregular fine foliage, coherent architectural scale, subtle cool charcoal atmosphere and amber light pools, restrained reflections, rich physically plausible surface detail and shadow depth. Long elegant ground-level architectural lights, not orange neon outlines. Composition: widescreen 16:9, elevated camera looking down about 30 degrees, grounded natural perspective, main facility lower-right, grid equipment mid-right upper-left of facility, neighborhood upper-right. LEFT 38 percent is calm nearly black #080808 atmospheric negative space for future HTML copy, containing no required subjects. The subjects must all remain discernible in the right 60 percent. Fade the scene naturally into almost-black at every perimeter for seamless dark webpage integration; no hard rectangular image boundary, no card border. Premium architecture-journal photographic realism, crisp but restrained, no toy model, no low-poly geometry, no repeated identical trees, no vaporwave, no exaggerated sci-fi, no cyan neon, no skyline or extra facilities. Landscape only; do not render a website mockup. Intended as explicitly labeled synthetic conceptual artwork, not evidence of an existing location or delivered community benefits.
